review:
Deep Sea is a neon underwater slot from 2019 with 15 paylines. During free spins, collecting three special symbols triggers 10 wild spins, giving the bonus a clear mini goal.

BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 2,692x maximum. Free spins are frequent, arriving roughly once every 73 spins on average, which keeps the game moving. The RTP is 94.14%, well below modern standards, so it's best enjoyed in demo for its visuals rather than for long-term value. A relaxed, atmospheric option.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 73 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
